stimulus: It is needless to say that washing hands is very important for us. It is certainly (a) ⎯⎯ important issue. Again, we should wash hands after touching sick members (f) ⎯⎯ our family and pet animals. Washing hands is also strictly recommended after coming back (g) ⎯⎯ outside. Washing hands in (h) ⎯⎯ proper wav may help us stay away from corona virus, (i) ⎯⎯ reason is that corona virus spreads through touch. So, it is (j) ⎯⎯ important to keep our hands clean.
